Version 0.1.0: 144 operations. Every path is on `https://api.almena.id`; those under `/api/v1` speak JSON. Most need `Authorization: Bearer <token>`: an [API token](/integrate/quick-start/) or a sign-in. A refusal answers `{"detail": "<code>"}` — every code is in [Errors](/reference/errors/).
